description: This file defines the Gratuity class and related functions for calculating gratuity amounts, work experience, and generating general ledger entries within an ERP system, specifically for handling employee gratuity processing.

classes.name: Gratuity
classes.description: A class representing the gratuity process, including validation, GL entry creation, and status management for employee gratuity records.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the gratuity record, calculates work experience and amount, and updates status.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon submission, such as creating GL entries.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon cancellation, including ignoring linked DOCTYPEs and reversing GL entries.

methods.name: create_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates general ledger entries for the gratuity transaction, either creating or canceling entries.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Prepares GL entry data for payable and expense accounts based on gratuity amount.

methods.name: set_total_advance_paid
methods.description: Calculates total paid amount against the gratuity and updates status accordingly.
